import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query mean hourly AQHI for weekdays (Jan 20-24, 2025) and weekend (Jan 25-26, 2025)
query = text("""
SELECT 
    AVG(aqhi) as mean_aqhi,
    CASE 
        WHEN datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00' AND datetime < '2025-01-25 00:00:00' THEN 'weekday'
        WHEN datetime >= '2025-01-25 00:00:00' AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00' THEN 'weekend'
    END as period
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period
""")

df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(df)

# Assign results to variables
weekday_mean_aqhi = float(df[df['period'] == 'weekday']['mean_aqhi'].values[0])
weekend_mean_aqhi = float(df[df['period'] == 'weekend']['mean_aqhi'].values[0])

print(f"Weekday mean AQHI (Jan 20-24): {weekday_mean_aqhi}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI (Jan 25-26): {weekend_mean_aqhi}")
